content_sections.heading: About VISL
content_sections.text: Vizhinjam International Seaport Limited (VISL) is the organisation where this post sits. The Centre for Management Development, an autonomous institution under the Government of Kerala, has invited the applications on its behalf.

content_sections.heading: VISL General Manager (Environment) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay within this range shall be fixed based on the candidate's relevant experience and any additional qualification acquired.

content_sections.heading: VISL General Manager (Environment) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is 60 years. Age and experience are both calculated as on 1 October 2026. M.Tech in Environmental Engineering from an AICTE recognised institution. The qualification must be from a recognised University or Institute. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in a senior-level position in handling environment-related matters, such as: Environmental clearance Statutory environmental compliance Pollution control CRZ matters Coastal/marine environmental issues Environmental impact assessment Waste management or other environment-related matters Oversight of the Port Operations within the framework of the MARPOL Protocol Applicants must be citizens of India. See the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Both the opening and closing dates are inclusive.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: CMD reserves the right to decide the selection process based on requirements. It may include any of the following, or any combination of them: Application screening Criteria-based screening Written test Group discussion Skill test/proficiency test Interview CMD/VISL reserves the rules for cut-off marks and shortlisting at every stage. CMD may send intimation to download call letters through the registered e-mail ID, so keep email notifications on and check the spam or junk folder regularly.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contract basis for one year. The contract can be extended based on requirement and the candidate's performance. CMD/VISL may modify or cancel the notification, revise the number of posts or stop the recruitment altogether at any time without assigning any reason. Any false or incorrect information found at any stage makes the candidature or appointment liable to be cancelled or terminated without notice. CMD/VISL may debar a candidate for malpractice, misconduct or a fraudulent claim of any benefit, relaxation or concession.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VISL General Manager (Environment) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check your eligibility against the notification before you apply. Make sure you have a valid personal email ID and mobile number, and keep both active until the recruitment process is complete. Open the online application on the CMD website . Fill in all relevant fields. Incomplete or incorrect forms will be summarily rejected, and later corrections will not be entertained. Scan your latest photograph and upload it in JPG format, less than 200KB. Sign in full on white paper, scan the signature and upload it in JPG format, less than 50KB. Initials and signatures in capital letters are not permitted. Upload your certificates and supporting documents, then submit the application. The original or provisional certificate for each educational qualification, issued by a competent authority. Experience certificates showing the date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, with the signature and seal of the authorised person. An equivalency certificate from the competent authority, if your qualification is equivalent to the prescribed one. CMD may also call for additional documentary evidence of qualifications, experience or other eligibility requirements. Self-declarations, undertakings and other self-certified statements are not accepted as proof of qualification or experience.

faq.question: Q1. Can retired officers apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. For retired hands, the salary will be fixed as per Government norms, which the notice gives as last drawn salary minus pension.

faq.question: Q2. Will a pay slip or appointment letter count as proof of experience?
faq.answer: No. Appointment letters, salary certificates and pay slips are not accepted in place of a work experience certificate.

faq.question: Q3. What if I cannot get a certificate for my current job?
faq.answer: For your latest experience only, you may upload an affidavit giving the employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks and responsibilities.

faq.question: Q4. Can I upload mark sheets instead of my degree certificate?
faq.answer: No. Applications with mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets or statements in place of the original or provisional certificate will be rejected.

faq.question: Q5. What happens if my qualification is only equivalent to the M.Tech required?
faq.answer: You must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority. Without it, your application shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Can a photo or experience certificate get my application rejected?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications with a blurred or illegible photograph or signature, or with ambiguous experience certificates, will be rejected.

faq.question: Q7. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted about the selection process, by email, SMS or phone call.

faq.question: Q8. Whom do I contact for problems with the online form?
faq.answer: Call the help desk on 0471 2320101 ext: 237,250, between 10 am and 5 pm on working days (Monday to Friday).
